## Required assertions

- [ ] No employer source, private documentation, protocol, test vector, customer data, credential, artifact or internal infrastructure was used.
- [ ] No private CodexDoc URL or content is included.
- [ ] Every imported path is mapped to an exact public source blob.
- [ ] LICENSE and NOTICE obligations are preserved or the PR is blocked.
- [ ] The exact-subject SBOM is updated, or this PR truthfully remains pre-SBOM and non-releaseable.
- [ ] A Human contributor added their own DCO sign-off when required; automation did not invent one.
- [ ] This PR does not claim employer non-use, non-overlap, legal clearance, release or production readiness without the owning Human receipt.
